# DV Edu — Education Apps (for LLMs / coding agents)

> Canonical human docs: /en/edu/overview · Machine API: /edu/openapi.yaml · Agent page: /en/edu/agent-spec

## Product
- Classroom Hub = edu.daven.ai (dv-edu). Hosts classes, activities, credits.
- Education app = your HTTPS web app, loaded in an iframe by the Hub.
- Daven AI = generation backend. Browser must NEVER hold API keys.

## Embed contract (deterministic)
Edu opens: `{hostedUrl}?session={TOKEN}&proxy={PROXY_BASE}`
- Default PROXY_BASE production: `https://edu.daven.ai/api/v1/mcp-proxy`
- Local Hub: `http://localhost:3001/api/v1/mcp-proxy`
- App MUST read `session` + `proxy` from URL search params.
- App MUST call Daven only via PROXY_BASE (paths below).
- App MUST send session on requests:
  - Header `Authorization: Bearer {session}`
  - AND/OR Header `X-Edu-Session: {session}`
  - Optional query `?session=` on some GETs

## Forbidden
- Putting MCP / Daven secrets in frontend env or bundles
- Calling daven.ai / app.daven.ai directly from the browser in Edu mode
- Relying on popups / top-level redirects inside iframe
- Overwriting student-authored text with AI without an explicit user action

## Proxy paths (relative to PROXY_BASE)
| Method | Path | Auth | Notes |
| GET | /health | no | health |
| GET | /api/account | yes | account/quota |
| POST | /api/quote | yes | JSON body model-specific |
| POST | /api/upload-url | yes | upload URL |
| POST | /api/media/create | yes | start job |
| POST | /api/media/get | yes | poll job |
| GET | /api/catalog?kind=voices | yes | catalog |

## Response envelope
Success: `{ "status": "success", "data": ..., "code": "", "message": "" }`
Error: `{ "status": "error", "error": { "code": string, "message": string, "detail"?: any } }`
401 = invalid/missing session

## Recommended client flow
1. quote → 2. media/create → 3. poll media/get → 4. preview/download
If file upload: upload-url → PUT bytes → create

## Minimal TypeScript client
```ts
const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);
const session = params.get("session");
const proxy = (params.get("proxy") || "https://edu.daven.ai/api/v1/mcp-proxy").replace(/\/$/, "");
async function davenFetch(path: string, init?: RequestInit) {
  const res = await fetch(`${proxy}${path.startsWith("/") ? path : `/${path}`}`, {
    ...init,
    headers: {
      Accept: "application/json",
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      ...(session
        ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${session}`, "X-Edu-Session": session }
        : {}),
      ...(init?.headers ?? {}),
    },
  });
  const json = await res.json();
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(json?.error?.message || res.statusText);
  return json;
}
```

## Acceptance tests (pass/fail)
1. With session+proxy in URL, GET `{proxy}/api/account` returns HTTP 200 and `status==="success"`.
2. Without session headers, same call returns 401.
3. Network tab shows requests to Edu proxy host, not daven.ai origin.
4. App renders usable UI inside iframe sandbox (scripts, forms, same-origin).

## Reference implementation
- Repo: dv_mcp/apps/sihwa_project
- Key files: src/lib/daven-config.ts, src/lib/daven.ts
- Example host: https://sihwa-project-teal.vercel.app
